summary: ONE-OFF pilot reset. Transactionally wipes ALL client/prospect data for the single Blue Tick tenant (9 leads, 4 clients, 6 companies + their full graph across ~150 tables) so the practice starts the pilot from zero. Practice CONFIG is preserved (org/settings/users, services_catalog, templates, automations, rate tables, master COA). audit_log KEPT. Every DELETE is org-scoped; no unscoped delete.
pre_apply_requirement: Take a database backup/snapshot before applying — this is IRREVERSIBLE.

safety_review.unscoped_delete_check: PASS — every DELETE carries organization_id / org_id, a subquery into an org-scoped parent, or the _subjects id set. No unscoped DELETE.
safety_review.transaction_fix: Removed explicit BEGIN/COMMIT (0 of 466 repo migrations use them → runner wraps each file in its own transaction; explicit block risked mis-nest / premature COMMIT / partial delete). _subjects temp table changed to session-scoped (no ON COMMIT DROP) + explicit DROP, so it is robust whether or not a surrounding transaction exists. All statements idempotent → safe to re-run.
safety_review.fk_order: 10-tier leaf→root order derived from grepping all REFERENCES; circular NO-ACTION pairs (filings↔snapshots, jobs↔workpaper_instances) pre-NULLed at the top.
safety_review.config_preserved: organizations, org_settings, organization_users/profiles, services_catalog, canonical_* templates/rules, templates, automation_* config, rate tables, master/org-level COA rows (per-company COA deleted with companies). See migration header.

flags_requiring_owner_confirmation: bookkeeping_accounts (per-company Chart of Accounts): DELETED, scoped by client/company membership. Any org-level/master COA rows (client_id/company_id NULL) are PRESERVED. Confirm you consider the per-company chart of accounts to be client data (it is removed with the company).

approval_revocation_log: an audit-family table but with a HARD FK to filings, so its rows for this org ARE deleted (forced by removing the test filings). This erases the filing-approval-revocation trail for the TEST data only. audit_log itself is fully preserved.
period_locks (accounting period locks): DELETED — treated as client-scoped. Confirm.
Subject-scoped runtime rows (email_queue, notifications, sla_instances, automation_events/executions) are deleted only where tied to a deleted subject id; org/system-level rows are preserved.

expected_objects.object: 0 rows remain for org a857a12c-... in leads, clients, companies, jobs, quotes, onboarding_applications, engagements, deadlines
expected_objects.verify_via: db_select each table filtered organization_id eq a857a12c-a125-41de-bb45-9eb556d5b467 → expect 0 rows.

expected_objects.object: Practice config still present: services_catalog, automation_rules, organization_users rows remain for the org
expected_objects.verify_via: db_select services_catalog / automation_rules / organization_users filtered to the org → expect rows still present.
